999008199.text:
あれ？　向こうに獣人じゃない方がいますね……
旅行者でしょうか？

localizations.en: Huh? There's someone over there who's not a beastkin... A traveler, maybe?

999008199.text:
風の向くまま気の向くまま……
ここで出会うのも運命ってやつかもね

localizations.en: Going where the wind takes me... Running into you here must be fate.

999008199.text: 変てこ仮面さん！
お前、なぜベスティラに？

localizations.en: What are you doing in Bestira?

999008199.text:
変てこ仮面さんは砂漠でその仮面、
暑くないんですか？　確実にムレますよね？

localizations.en: Doesn't wearing that mask in the desert make you hot? It's gotta be stuffy under there!

999008199.text:
フッ……ファッションっていうのは、
時として我慢が必要なものなんだよ
おい、話を聞け。タイニーも世間話はいい

localizations.en: Listen when I'm talking. And Tiny, enough with the small talk.

999008199.text:
相変わらず余裕のない人だねえ……
賞金稼ぎの俺がここにいる理由は１つだけ

localizations.en: Relentless as ever... There's only one reason a bounty hunter like me would be here.

999008199.text:
悪名高い「ヌルスラの鷹」が、ベスティラに
入国したというネタを掴んだからだよ

localizations.en: I caught wind that the infamous 'Hawk of Nurslath' entered Bestira.

999008199.text:
「ヌルスラの鷹」……あっ！
確か、ブラオールの掲示板に載ってた賞金首！

localizations.en: The 'Hawk of Nurslath'... Oh! That's one of the bounties on the board in Braulle!

999008199.text: ここに「ヌルスラの鷹」が……！

localizations.en: The Hawk of Nurslath is here...!

999008199.text:
っと、いつになく真剣だね。
どうしちゃったのさ、タイニー

localizations.en: Wow, you're unusually serious. What's gotten into you, Tiny?

999008199.text:
タイニーはその賞金首と同郷……
ヌルスラの出身なんだ

localizations.en: Tiny is from the same place as that bounty... She's from Nurslath.

999008199.text:
ヌルスラは最後の島とか墓場島とかいわれる所でね。
様々な理由で行き場を失った者たちの島なのさ

localizations.en: Nurslath is known as the Last Island, or the Graveyard Isle. It's where people with nowhere else to go end up.

999008199.text:
ありとあらゆる犯罪が横行し、平均寿命も最低の魔窟。
諸島同盟にも未加入……いや、最近加入したか？

localizations.en: Crime runs rampant, life expectancy is abysmal—a real hellhole. They weren't part of the Federation either... though I think they joined recently?

999008199.text: はい……だから私は、こうして監察官になれたんです

localizations.en: Yes... That's why I was able to become an inspector.

999008199.text: あー、ごめん。前に変な名前とか言っちゃって……

localizations.en: Oh, sorry. I said something about your weird name before...

999008199.text:
いえ、いいんです。色々言われるのは慣れてますから。
でも……ヌルスラにもいい人はいるんです

localizations.en: No, it's okay. I'm used to people saying things. But... there are good people in Nurslath too.

999008199.text:
私を助けてくれたお兄ちゃんとか……
治安だって徐々に良くなってる……

localizations.en: Like the man who helped me... And things are slowly getting better there...

999008199.text:
それなのに、こういう風に名乗ってる悪い人がいるから
ヌルスラはやっぱり悪い島だ～ってなるんです！

localizations.en: But when bad people use our island's name like this, everyone just thinks Nurslath is still a terrible place!

999008199.text:
あの場所は変わりつつあるんだって示すためにも
「ヌルスラの鷹」を見つけたら絶対捕まえます！！

localizations.en: I need to catch the Hawk of Nurslath to prove that things are changing there!

999008199.text: タイニー、気持ちは分かるが本来の目的を忘れるな

localizations.en: Tiny, I understand how you feel, but don't lose sight of our original objective.

999008199.text:
おっと、競争相手を増やしちゃったかな。
ま、その様子じゃ情報も持ってなさそうだし……

localizations.en: Oops, looks like I made myself some competition. Well, you clearly don't have any leads yet...

999008199.text:
せいぜい、本来の目的とやらを頑張りなよ。
あいつの賞金は俺のものだ

localizations.en: Better focus on that original objective of yours. That bounty's mine.

999008199.text:
……獣人の行方不明事件に、時を同じくして
賞金首の入国……か。捜査に思い込みは禁物だが

localizations.en: ...Missing beastkin and a wanted criminal entering the country at the same time. I shouldn't jump to conclusions, but...

999008199.text:
なんだか匂うね。
この線、繋がってんじゃないの？

localizations.en: Something smells fishy. You think these cases are connected?

999008199.text:
そうにしろ、そうじゃないにしろ……
ベスティラ、一筋縄じゃいかなそうな島ね

localizations.en: Either way... Bestira isn't going to be straightforward, is it?

999008199.text:
ヌルスラ、人攫い……もしかして、あの教団が？
でも、壊滅したはずじゃ……ざ、残党とか！？

localizations.en: Nurslath, kidnappings... Could it be that cult? But they were destroyed... U-unless there are remnants!?

999008199.text: だとしたら……なおさら絶対に捕まえなきゃ……！

localizations.en: If that's the case... I have to catch them no matter what...!

999008199.text: タイニー……
